messages.text: 'Nowhere else I want to be' - Norris extends McLaren contract until 2030

metadata.summary: Reigning Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris has extended his contract with McLaren until at least 2030.
metadata.content: Lando Norris: McLaren driver signs contract extension until 2030 with target of more world championships | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Lando Norris: McLaren driver signs contract extension until 2030 with target of more world championships Lando Norris commits long-term future to McLaren; reigning world champion agrees multi-year extension to previous deal; the Brit has already driven in a team record 163 grands prix for McLaren; watch the Italian Grand Prix at Monza live on Sky Sports F1 on September 4-6 Saturday 29 August 2026 14:42, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lando Norris sits down with Sky Sports' Rob Jones to discuss extending his stay with McLaren in a multi-year contract extension. Reigning Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris has extended his contract with McLaren until at least 2030. The 26-year-old Brit's previous extension, which was announced ahead of the start of the 2024 season, was understood to tie him to the team until at least the end of 2027. He will now stay at McLaren for at least another four seasons with the extended deal to the end of 2030 including "a multi-year option to commit beyond that date".
